'''2010 Worlds Day 3 Matthew Sokol LS You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Sokol]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Sheet lists 58 Reserve Deck cards (Sai'torr Kal Fas and I Must Be Allowed To Speak struck).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed / It Could Be Worse]]
* '''Username:''' Mr. Purple
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
